name: Coromandel Cuisine of India
notes: Menu transcribed item by item from the restaurant's own website; prices and descriptions as printed. Address from website. Phone from website. Hours not listed online.
address: 25 Old Kings Hwy N Darien, Fairfield County 06820 USA

sections.name: APPETIZER
items: Coromandel's Sham Savera

Spinach and homemade cheese dumplings, accompanied by a delightful tangy tomato honey sauce. This delectable dish is none other than the chef's very own signature special, meticulously prepared with the utmost care and expertise.
Kombu Barthad
A delectable combination of grilled wild mushrooms infused with an array of Southern spices and fragrant herbs, presented atop a delicate and fluffy pancake.
Vegetable Samosa

An exquisite pastry meticulously crafted to perfection. Immerse yourself in the delicate blend of flavors as you bite into the flaky crust, unveiling a harmonious combination of spiced potatoes and tender peas. Indulge in this culinary masterpiece, expertly prepared to satisfy even the most discerning palates.
Lasuni Gobi

From the stunning landscapes of the majestic Himalayan rim emerges a delectable creation. Behold the miniature cauliflower, delicately tossed with the vibrant flavors of tomato, garlic, and cilantro. This exquisite dish is undoubtedly a must-try item on our distinguished menu.
Imli Baingan
A delicately seasoned Grilled Eggplant, expertly layered in a tantalizing tamarind sauce, showcases the exquisite flavors of this renowned Gujarati specialty.
Malai Katti Roll

A meticulously prepared ensemble of delicately spiced panir and vegetables, meticulously wrapped in a delectable whole wheat crepe. Experience the epitome of gourmet excellence with this culinary masterpiece.
Dahi Batata Sev Poori

A widely favored street delicacy, the small semolina puffs known as pooris are skillfully stuffed with a delectable filling of lentils and potatoes. To enhance the flavors, these delectable puffs are elegantly garnished with a dollop of creamy yogurt and a sprinkle of fragrant herbs.
Ragada Patties

Delicious spiced potato patties delicately layered with chickpeas and a medley of aromatic herbs. This delectable street snack hails from the vibrant streets of Delhi, showcasing the culinary prowess of the region.
Samosa Chat

A delectable street snack from Mumbai, consisting of perfectly sliced samosa, delicately layered with a rich chickpea curry, accompanied by refreshing mint chutney, tangy tamarind chutney, creamy yogurt infused with honey, and a sprinkle of aromatic herbs.
Masala Dosa

Dosa is a delectable delicacy that consists of a delicate, paper-thin crepe made from a delightful blend of rice and lentils. This mouthwatering treat is generously filled with a tantalizing mixture of spiced potatoes and peas, creating a harmonious symphony of flavors. Accompanying this culinary masterpiece are two delectable accompaniments – the creamy coconut chutney and the aromatic sambar. Indulge in this exquisite dish and experience a true delight for your taste buds. (Appetizer for two)
Vegetable Platter

A diverse selection of vegetables has been coated in a delicious gram flour batter and then deep-fried to perfection. Also known as pakoras, these bites are very common street food found all over the Indian subcontinent and in plenty of Indian menus around the world, consisting of delectable fritters made from eggplant, potato, cauliflower, spinach, and onion.
Cafreal Kebab

The succulent chicken kebab is delicately infused with an exquisite blend of green herbs, crafted from the finest ginger, garlic, cilantro, mint, and curry leaves spices. This culinary masterpiece is a true testament to the unique flavors of Goan cuisine.
Chili Paneer
Deep-fried cubes of Paneer, skillfully combined with onions, peppers, aromatic curry leaves, juicy tomatoes, and a blend of exquisite spices.
Badami Jhinga

An exquisite dish that showcases the rich flavors of grilled shrimps, tantalizingly tossed in a delicate tomato sauce infused with a gentle touch of mildness. Complementing this culinary masterpiece are the crisp almonds, adding a delightful crunch, and the fragrant green herbs, enhancing the overall aroma and taste. Originating from the Saurashtra region, this culinary gem exemplifies the culinary prowess of the professionals behind its creation.
Calamari Coromandel

Fresh Calamari, expertly stir-fried alongside the aromatic blend of onions, bell pepper, and garlic, creating a harmonious symphony of flavors. The dish is further adorned with the delicate touch of curry leaves, paying homage to the culinary traditions of the illustrious Coromandel coast.
Sunhari Potli
A delectable combination of spiced ground lamb and green peas enclosed within a delicate Indian pastry. A savory delight hailing from the illustrious region of Rajasthan.
Andhra Chili Chicken

Meticulously coated chicken tenders are skillfully deep-fried to achieve an ideal, irresistibly crispy outer layer. These juicy chicken tenders are then elegantly mixed with onions, peppers, tomatoes, and a harmonious medley of aromatic spices. The outcome is a captivating gastronomic creation that will undoubtedly enchant your palate. Originating from the region of Andhra Pradesh, this dish is a true testament to culinary finesse.
MYSOOR MASALA DOSA

A signature classic from Karnataka. Our golden, crispy rice and lentil crepe is generously smeared with a spicy, aromatic red chutney and stuffed with a savory spiced potato mash. Served with fresh coconut chutney and hot sambar

sections.name: SOUPS, SALADS & SIDES
items: Nimma Rasam

A traditional South Indian runny soup, is renowned as a comforting staple throughout the year. Crafted with a delicate blend of lentils, aromatic spices, and fragrant herbs such as curry leaves and coriander leaves, it is believed to possess healing and nourishing properties, especially during instances of digestive upsets, colds, and coughs.
Mulligatawny Soup
A delightful blend of lentils and vegetables. Renowned as the epitome of soup excellence in both India and Sri Lanka.
Tadka Dal

Yellow lentils are skillfully crafted, with utmost attention paid to the precise blending of the highest quality turmeric, cumin seeds, and a hint of fiery red chilies, as well as the fragrant cilantro.
Hot Pickle
Assorted medley of pickled vegetables with a tantalizing blend of spices.
Mango Chutney
Mango chutney is an exquisite blend of flavors, combining the sweetness of mangoes with a tantalizing kick of spice. It is a delectable mango relish that perfectly balances the taste buds.
Raita
The renowned Indian yogurt relish, tantalizes the taste buds with its exquisite blend of cucumber, carrot, and cumin.
Mast Mast Murgh

Our menu boasts a must-try item: the delectable Organic Chicken Tikka paired with the refreshing Massage Kale Salad garnished with fresh coconut. Indulge in this exquisite combination and experience culinary excellence at its finest.
Coromandel Saladora
Our exquisite blend of organic greens and nutrient-rich chickpeas are delicately tossed together, perfectly harmonizing with our signature ginger balsamic dressing.
Kachumber Salad

A highly sought-after Indian salad that showcases the perfect combination of cucumber, carrot, onion, tomato, and a delightful blend of herbs, all brought together with a tantalizing Chaat masala vinaigrette.
Chatpatti Calamari Salad
Tender Calamari rings served atop a bed of Kale and tropical tangy dressing.
Kids Meal- Chicken nuggets with fries
Kids Meal -Macaroni & Cheese

sections.name: TANDOOR SE / FROM THE GRILL
items: Ghustaba

The most exquisite New Zealand lamb chops are meticulously cooked in a traditional Tandoor oven. These succulent double chops are skillfully marinated in a delightful combination of yogurt infused with the aromatic essence of nutmeg and ajwain. To perfectly complement this culinary masterpiece, we serve it with a harmonious medley of pan-fried vegetables, creating an overall symphony of flavors. This dish beautifully highlights the distinctive and alluring allure of Kashmiri cuisine, establishing itself as a true specialty that is guaranteed to satisfy even the most discerning palates.
Angare Badak

The succulent duck breast is expertly marinated with creamy yogurt, fragrant spices, and then masterfully grilled to perfection in the traditional tandoor oven. It is elegantly served alongside tender roasted cauliflower and zucchini, creating a harmonious and exquisite culinary experience.
Shrimp Malai Kebab

Jumbo shrimp meticulously marinated in a delectable blend of yogurt, ginger, white pepper, and saffron. This exquisite culinary masterpiece is a true testament to the rich heritage of Mughal cuisine, a specialty that has garnered immense popularity among those eager to explore the diverse flavors of Indian gastronomy.
Samundari Toofan

Exquisite chunks of Halibut or Scottish Salmon, sourced from the wild, are artfully immersed in a yogurt-based marinade infused with the subtle flavors of ginger, garlic, Kashmiri mild spices, dry fenugreek leaves, and cilantro. These delectable morsels are then expertly grilled in a traditional tandoor oven, resulting in an unparalleled culinary experience. For those opting for the Salmon, a generous discount of $15 is graciously offered.
Hazarvi Murgh

The marination process for the organic chicken breast involves a delightful blend of yogurt, white pepper, and saffron. This exquisite combination not only amplifies the natural flavors of the chicken but also guarantees a delectable and nourishing meal choice. It's a culinary masterpiece that is suitable for both children and adults, making it a truly versatile option.
Tandoori Shrimp

Grilled large, succulent shrimp expertly marinated in a flavorful combination of tangy tomato puree, fragrant Degi Mirch, aromatic cumin, sweet honey, refreshing coriander-infused yogurt, zesty lemon juice, and a superb blend of spices.
Chicken Tikka

Chicken tikka is a delectable chicken delicacy that gained immense popularity in the Indian subcontinent during the majestic Mughal era. This culinary masterpiece has captivated the taste buds of people in India, Bangladesh, Pakistan, and even the United Kingdom. The essence of this dish lies in the meticulous process of baking tender boneless chicken pieces to perfection. These succulent morsels are skillfully marinated in a harmonious blend of Indian spices and dahi (yogurt). For those seeking an organic option, an additional $3.50 is charged.
Tandoori Chicken

Tandoori chicken, known as the "King of Kebabs," is a renowned Indian delicacy. This succulent dish is prepared by marinating chicken with a harmonious blend of over 36 exquisite spices and creamy yogurt. It is hailed as the ultimate choice for those seeking the finest barbecued chicken. Originating from the illustrious State of Punjab, this dish embodies the pinnacle of culinary craftsmanship.
Sabji Raiwala
Cauliflower, paneer, corn, broccoli, zucchini, mushrooms, and sweet peppers expertly cooked in a clay oven, resulting in a wholesome and satisfying dish.

sections.name: CHICKEN ENTREE'S
items: Chicken Tikka Masala
A beloved classic from Punjab, where succulent chicken breast is expertly grilled in a traditional tandoor oven and then simmered to perfection in a luscious tomato curry.
Murgh Shahi Korma

Chicken is prepared in a delicately seasoned curried creamy cashew sauce infused with fragrant cardamom, white pepper, and dry fenugreek leaves. A touch of saffron adds a regal touch to this dish, harkening back to the culinary traditions of the esteemed Mughal dynasty.
Amchuri Murgh
Delicately prepared cubes of chicken breast are masterfully cooked in a unique and flavorful mango-spiced sauce, hailing from the esteemed state of Karnataka.
Chicken Madras

Chicken chunks stewed in a delectable coconut hot curry sauce, with a touch of fiery red chilies and fragrant mustard seeds, all enhanced by the exotic blend of asafetida and curry leaves. Straight from the culinary wonders of Tamil Nadu, this dish is sure to tantalize your taste buds.
Milagu Kozhi Chettinad
The Deviled Chicken is expertly prepared in a rich black peppercorn curry sauce. This mouthwatering dish is a true testament to the culinary expertise of the Chettiar's kitchen.
Chicken Vindaloo

Chicken vindaloo is a distinguished delicacy hailing from the beautiful region of Goa. Prepared with utmost expertise, this culinary masterpiece showcases tender chicken immersed in a tantalizingly spicy sauce made with pickled whole spices, chili paste, and sour tomato curry sauce, perfectly complemented by the presence of gourmet potatoes.
Murgh Dhaniwal

Delicately spiced chicken infused with our homemade yogurt, paired with the aromatic blend of freshly ground coriander and cilantro. Originating from the esteemed state of Bengal, this culinary masterpiece awaits your indulgence.
Kori Nilgiri

Chicken tenders delicately sautéed with a tantalizing blend of green herbs, coconut curry, and a medley of aromatic spices, all expertly prepared in the exquisite Nilgiri sauce. This culinary masterpiece hails from the majestic Blue Mountains of Tamil Nadu, where every bite transports you to a realm of refined flavors and culinary excellence.
Chicken Saag

Chicken is prepared using a gentle blend of aromatic spices, resulting in a pleasantly mild flavor. The dish features a smooth and velvety texture, accompanied by a rich spinach gravy that emanates warmth. This particular culinary creation hails from the esteemed region of Hariyana in North India.
Vaechana Kodi

Tender chicken pieces are expertly combined with aromatic ginger, garlic, richly caramelized onions, fiery green chilies, and fragrant curry leaves. This delightful medley is infused with a tantalizing blend of spicy dry coconut, fresh coriander, and the exquisite essence of cardamom. It is a culinary masterpiece, showcasing the unique flavors of Andhra, an esteemed coromandel specialty.
CHICKEN MAPPAS

Mappas is an exquisite delicacy that hails from Kerala and is deeply rooted in the culinary traditions of the Syrian Christian community. This delectable dish features tender chunks of chicken, meticulously cooked in a rich and creamy coconut milk base. What sets Mappas apart is the careful hand-roasting of spices, which enhances the flavors and creates a harmonious blend of aromatic notes. The inclusion of tamarind and curry leaves adds a tangy and refreshing element to this culinary masterpiece. Meticulously prepared and expertly crafted, Mappas is truly a testament to the artistry and skill of Kerala's culinary heritage.

sections.name: SEAFOOD ENTREE'S
items: Alleppey Fish Curry

Freshly caught Halibut or Scottish Salmon cooked in a rich coconut milk broth infused with aromatic turmeric, fragrant ginger, and tangy raw mangoes. This exquisite dish is highly regarded by the skilled fishermen of Kerala. (Enjoy a $5 discount on the salmon option.)
Kolmino Patio

The Parsi style prawn curry, also referred to as, is a distinctive curry that encompasses a harmonious blend of contrasting flavors. This unique curry boasts a delightful sharpness from the chilies, a subtle sweetness derived from the jaggery, and a tangy sourness infused by the tamarind and lemon juice.
Meen Travancore

Freshly caught Halibut or Scottish Salmon cooked in a delectable Travancore sauce, infused with authentic southern spices including Turmeric, Red Chili Powder, Coriander Powder, Fenugreek Powder, Kokum, and Curry Leaves. Enjoy the exquisite flavors of this dish, perfectly balanced with a touch of tanginess. Plus, you can avail a $5 discount on the salmon option.
Manglorean Prawn

Black tiger prawns are expertly cooked in a delectable coconut stew, enriched with the invigorating flavors of ginger and curry leaves. This culinary masterpiece hails from the magnificent coast of Karnataka.
Dahi Dhani Jhinga

Fresh prawns are skillfully prepared, combining the natural goodness of organic yogurt, fragrant coriander, and a blend of aromatic spices. This exquisite dish showcases the culinary expertise of the Bengal region.
Nellore Chapla Koora

The Spicy Wild Caught Halibut OR the Scottish Salmon Curry from Nellore. These delectable dishes are expertly prepared using a combination of flavorful chilies, aromatic poppy seeds, and delicate sesame seeds. As a special promotion, we are offering a discount of $5 off the price of the salmon.
Prawn Balchao
Prawns, a delectable delicacy from the coastal state of Goa, are skillfully prepared with a delightful blend of freshly crushed tomatoes, aromatic curry leaves, and an assortment of pickle spices.

sections.name: LAMB ENTREE'S
items: Lal Mass

The meat curry from Rajasthan is a delectable dish that showcases the culinary expertise of the region. This particular curry is prepared using tender lamb, which is cooked to perfection in a sauce made from yogurt and a selection of fiery spices, including the renowned red Mathania chillies. It is worth noting that this dish is known for its intense heat and the abundance of garlic, which adds a distinct richness to the overall flavor profile.
Balti Gosht

A delectable combination of tender lamb, vibrant bell peppers, flavorful sundried tomatoes, earthy mushrooms, and aromatic onions, expertly infused with the perfect balance of chilies and ground spices. This exquisite dish hails from the esteemed culinary traditions of the Baltistan region.
Kobbari Chops

A delectable tandoori rack of lamb, skillfully enveloped in a delicately spiced organic coconut milk sauce infused with the aromatic essence of fennel. This culinary masterpiece is a testament to the culinary expertise of Andhra cuisine, showcasing its unique flavors and specialties.
Gosht Kesar Pasanda

A delectable lamb stew simmered in a luscious blend of creamy cashew and almond sauce. This culinary masterpiece is sure to delight both young and grown-up palates alike. Experience a taste of royalty straight from the Mughal Emperor's table.
Phaal Gosht

The lamb dish is prepared with a unique combination of chili paste, incorporating the fiery flavors of Red Ghost Super Hot Pepper, Habanero, Carolina Reaper, and Scotch Bonnet. This delectable blend is complemented by the addition of onions, tomatoes, and a variety of spices. Renowned for its popularity in England, this dish is sure to satisfy even the most discerning palate.
Mirapakaya Mamsam Koora

We highly recommend tasting our exclusive creation, which cannot be found in any other Indian restaurant. Indulge in the delectable combination of tender lamb pieces immersed in a flavorful, spicy gravy infused with red chilies, coriander, yellow chilies, and a hint of ginger. This exquisite dish draws inspiration from the culinary traditions of the Deccan region.
Sagwala Gosht

A Punjabi specialty, lamb is skillfully prepared in a delicately spiced creamy spinach gravy, infused with the aromatic essence of dry fenugreek leaves, coriander, and ginger. The addition of Punjabi garam masala elevates the flavors to new heights, creating a culinary masterpiece.
Goat Uppu Kari

baby Goat is skillfully pan-roasted together with a fragrant medley of fennel, caramelized onions, red chilies, black stone flower, garlic, and curry leaves. This exquisite dish holds a special place of admiration in Tamil Nadu.
Salli Boti

In the realm of Parsi cuisine, we find a remarkable dish consisting of tender lamb, skillfully stewed with the delightful combination of apricots, onion, cinnamon, ajwain, cardamom, and mace. This exquisite creation is then crowned with a layer of irresistibly crispy potatoes.
Lamb Vindaloo

An exquisite culinary creation that showcases the skillful blending of flavors. Succulent chunks of lamb are meticulously immersed in a tantalizing tomato curry, creating a symphony of taste sensations. This remarkable dish is a testament to the influence of Portuguese cuisine and hails from the vibrant state of Goa. The addition of potatoes adds depth and complexity to the already perfect fusion of ingredients, elevating this gastronomic experience to new heights.
LAMB ROGAN JOSH

A delicious lamb dish that is highly regarded in the culinary world. Its rich flavors and tender meat make it a popular choice among food enthusiasts. The succulent pieces of lamb are cooked in a flavorful blend of aromatic spices and a creamy tomato-based sauce. The dish is prepared with great care and attention to detail, ensuring that each bite is a burst of exquisite taste. Lamb rogan josh is a masterpiece of culinary expertise, perfect for those who appreciate the finer flavors in life. From the state of Kashmir.
GOAT CURRY

Slowly simmered to perfection, savor the exquisite flavors of our renowned Baby Goat curry. Tenderly cooked on the bone and expertly seasoned with a blend of aromatic Rajasthani masalas, this dish is a true culinary masterpiece. Immerse yourself in the harmonious marriage of succulent meat, caramelized onions, and ripe tomatoes, resulting in a symphony of taste that will leave your palate longing for more.
LAMB VEPUDU

A delectable Andhra-style lamb roast is prepared with utmost expertise. The succulent lamb is skillfully combined with onions, curry leaves, sliced chili, coconut, cardamom, sesame, and peanut dry masala.
KEEMA MATAR

An essential and widely consumed dish in Pakistani and Bengali households, it is a delightful curry consisting of ground lamb and green peas, cooked with a blend of aromatic ingredients such as onions, bay leaves, cardamom, cinnamon, and star anise petals. The flavors are enhanced with the addition of ginger, garlic, turmeric powder, chili powder, coriander powder, cumin powder, curry powder, and dried fenugreek leaves (methi leaves). This traditional recipe showcases the culinary expertise and attention to detail that characterize professional cooking.
PUNJABI GOAT KADAI

A North Indian roadside classic. Tender cuts of bone-in goat are stir-fried in a traditional iron wok (Kadai) with cubes of bell peppers, onions, and tomatoes. The dish is finished with fresh ginger juliennes and crushed coriander seeds for a bold, rustic flavor.

sections.name: VEGETARIAN ENTREE'S
items: Bhindi Do Pyaza

A delightful family recipe brimming with an abundance of flavors. This culinary masterpiece showcases an array of fresh okra, expertly sautéed alongside fragrant onions, ripe tomatoes, and a medley of exquisite seasonings.
Malai Kofta
Vegetable and cheese dumplings are elegantly immersed in a delectable, mild creamy cashew and almond sauce, making this dish a beloved favorite among the Gujarati community.
Cholam Vendakkaya Varattiyathu

Our highly skilled chefs proudly present a culinary masterpiece rooted in tradition - the beloved recipe passed down from their mothers. Prepare to indulge in the delightful combination of tender okra and sweet corn kernels, expertly cooked with the luscious flavor of coconut, the aromatic essence of curry leaves, and the exquisite touch of gourmet dry masala. This exquisite dish is a true Kerala specialty, crafted with utmost care and precision to deliver a taste that is nothing short of extraordinary.
Sag Panir
A beloved Punjabi delicacy featuring a delightful combination of fresh spinach and homemade cheese that has stood the test of time.
Poriyal

A highly nutritious choice from the state of Tamil Nadu is the Broccoli, Carrots, & Cauliflower stir-Fry. This dish is prepared with a blend of coconut, mustard seeds, turmeric, ginger, and curry leaves. It offers a perfect balance of flavors and is sure to delight the taste buds.
Sambar

A stew prepared in the South Indian style featuring Eggplant, Carrots, Zucchini, Tomato, Drumstick (Muringa), Lentils, and enhanced with Tamarind and Asafoetida, all meticulously crafted in a vegan culinary approach.
Navaratan Korma

A delectable medley of assorted vegetables, including broccoli, carrots, homemade cheese, zucchini, and cauliflower, expertly stewed in a delicately spiced creamy cashew and almond sauce. This exquisite culinary creation is a true delicacy hailing from the enchanting region of Kashmir, renowned for its rich and flavorful cuisine.
Dalchi Khumb Kadai

Mushrooms and kidney beans are expertly infused with the fragrant combination of fenugreek and coriander, resulting in a delectable and nourishing dish. This culinary creation is further enhanced by a tantalizing tomato and onion sauce, making it a beloved staple in households across northern India.
Balti Baingan

Grilled baby eggplant, expertly seasoned with a blend of balti spices. This exquisite combination includes coriander, garlic, ginger, cumin, dundicut chilies, Ceylon cinnamon, brown mustard seeds, cardamom, clove, fennel, fenugreek, charnushka, ajwain, star anise, black cardamom, cilantro, anise seed, and bay leaf. Enhancing the flavors are the fragrant and fresh cilantro and fenugreek leaves. Originating from the esteemed Baltistan region.
Navabi Aloo Gobi

Baby purple potatoes and cauliflower are skillfully prepared with a flavorful blend of tomatoes, ginger, garlic, cumin, asafoetida, fenugreek, turmeric, coriander, and garam masala. This delectable dish, known for its popularity in Nepal and Punjab, showcases the culinary expertise of the chef.
Goothi Vonkaya Koora

One dish that is highly recommended at Coromandel Darien is the baby eggplant cooked with tamarind and peanut curry sauce. This dish boasts a unique and distinctive flavor that is influenced by the Deccan region. It is an absolute must-try for those looking to indulge in a professional culinary experience.
Sabji Sag Malai

Potato, cauliflower, and homemade cheese are skillfully combined with a flavorful blend of ginger, garlic, and homemade spices, all complemented by a luscious spinach gravy. This exquisite culinary creation is none other than a Delhi delicacy.
Chole Peshwari

Chickpeas and potatoes, highly favored by vegan food enthusiasts, are skillfully cooked in a delectable onion sauce that elegantly presents the delightful fusion of ginger, garlic, cumin, coriander, black cardamom, cinnamon, mace, fennel, dry mango powder, turmeric, and cilantro. This exceptional culinary creation is meticulously crafted in the time-honored Peshwari style, an exquisite masterpiece hailing from Pakistan.
Subji Bhaji

A specialty of Calcutta, this dish showcases a harmonious medley of mixed vegetables. Broccoli, carrots, cauliflower, zucchini, green peas, and chickpeas are stir-fried to perfection with a touch of ginger, mustard seeds, curry leaves, turmeric, and an array of aromatic spices. Notably, this culinary creation also incorporates the delightful addition of mashed potatoes and bell peppers. A testament to the rich heritage of Calcutta's Jewish cuisine, this dish exemplifies the skill and finesse of professional culinary craftsmanship.
Kara Kuzhambu

Carrot, broccoli, potatoes, cauliflower, green peas, and spinach are meticulously prepared in a tangy and nutty curry infused with the rich flavors of coconut, curry leaves, and chilies, showcasing the remarkable influence from the distinguished Madurai cuisine.
Mutter Panir

The Green Peas & paneer in a mildly spiced creamy tomato curry sauce is an esteemed dish from Bombay, celebrated for its genuine flavors and exceptional blend of ingredients. It stands as one of the timeless favorites in the realm of global Indian cuisine.
Dal Makhani

A delectable assortment of Punjabi lentil dishes, featuring kidney beans, black beans, split peas, and green moong lentils. These delectable creations are a staple in North Indian households, adding a touch of authenticity to any meal.
Dhingiri Saag
Baby bella mushrooms in a spinach grevy
Paneer Safed Korma

A dish fit for royalty. Soft cubes of paneer simmered in a luxurious, ivory-hued gravy made from ground cashews, almonds, and yoghurt. Delicately spiced with white pepper, green cardamom, and a hint of rose water.
Kadai Paneer

A North Indian favorite named after the traditional iron wok. Cubes of fresh paneer are tossed with bell peppers, onions, and tomatoes, then simmered with a coarse blend of roasted coriander seeds and dried red chilies for a bold, rustic flavor.
Paneer Jalfrezi

A colorful and robust dish. Batons of paneer are wok-tossed with a unique medley of baby eggplant, carrots, and bell peppers. The vegetables retain a pleasant crunch, coated in a rich, semi-dry sauce with hints of vinegar and cumin.
Paneer Khurchan

A North Indian specialty defined by its unique cooking technique. "Khurchan" means scraped—we slow-cook batons of fresh paneer with bell peppers and onions on a hot griddle, scraping the caramelized masala to create a smoky, semi-dry dish bursting with flavor
Paneer Makhani
India's most loved vegetarian curry. Soft cubes of homemade cottage cheese simmered in a buttery, velvety tomato cream sauce. Accented with aromatic dried fenugreek leaves (kasuri methi)
Paneer Butter Masala

A rich and luxurious dish. Fresh paneer cubes are bathed in a smooth, orange-hued gravy made from vine-ripened tomatoes, cashew paste, and churned butter. Finished with a swirl of cream for a satin-like texture.

sections.name: BREADS
items: Gluten Free Roti

Our establishment proudly offers the exquisite Gluten-Free Roti-Roti, skillfully crafted using a combination of rice and tapioca flour. This delectable creation caters to the discerning palates of those with dietary restrictions, ensuring a gluten-free experience without compromising on taste or quality. The careful selection of ingredients and meticulous preparation techniques guarantee a professional and exceptional dining experience. Indulge in the harmonious blend of flavors and textures that this Gluten-Free Roti-Roti has to offer, and savor a truly remarkable culinary delight.
Naan
Authentic Punjabi bread expertly baked in a traditional tandoor oven.
Garlic Naan
Naan bread is expertly seasoned with finely minced garlic and fragrant cilantro, then elegantly glazed with clarified butter.
Chili Naan
Naan bread, meticulously flavored with finely chopped green chilies and fresh cilantro, and expertly coated with clarified butter.
Chapati
Whole wheat bread, a staple in Indian households, is expertly grilled on a griddle.
Tandoori Roti
Exquisitely crafted whole wheat bread, expertly baked to perfection in a traditional Tandoor oven.
Tawa Paratha
Multi layered soft, fluffy whole wheat bread expertly grilled on the griddle.
Aloo Paratha
A renowned Indian school bread, expertly crafted with delectable spiced potatoes, serves as a delectable treat for discerning palates.
Peshwari Naan
Naan, a delectable Indian bread, is expertly crafted with a delectable stuffing of pistachios, almonds, cashew nuts, raisins, and homemade paneer - a delightful Indian cheese.
Cheese naan

Naan filled with the perfect combination of Monterey Jack, Medium Cheddar, Queso Quesadilla, and Asadero Cheeses and fresh cilantro. For those seeking an extra kick, we offer the option to add green chilies, elevating the flavors to a delightful fusion. This culinary creation bears a striking resemblance to the beloved cheese quesadilla, making it a tempting choice for those who appreciate both Indian and Mexican cuisines.
Kheema Naan

A popular delicacy found in the bustling streets of Delhi's Sadar Bazar is the delectable Naan filled with flavorful spiced ground lamb, accompanied by vibrant green peas and aromatic cilantro. This culinary masterpiece showcases the expertise of the renowned street food vendors, who have perfected the art of crafting this dish to perfection. Indulging in this gastronomic delight is a must for any food enthusiast seeking an authentic taste of Delhi's street food scene.
Onion Kulcha
Our delicious naan is expertly seasoned with a precise blend of finely chopped onions, vibrant bell peppers, and fragrant cilantro.

sections.name: RICE DISHES
items: CHICKEN BIRYANI

Biryani is an exquisite and timeless mixed rice dish that holds a significant place in the culinary traditions of India, particularly in the Mughlai cuisine. This culinary masterpiece can be traced back to its origins in the heart of central Asian cuisine, where it underwent a glorious fusion with the vibrant flavors and techniques of India. The harmonious combination of fluffy basmati rice and perfectly seasoned chicken in this dish is truly a work of art.
LAMB BIRYANI

Indian Lamb Biryani showcases a delightful blend of succulent lamb curry and aromatic saffron rice, beautifully presented in a casserole. Enhancing the experience, it is best accompanied by a refreshing cucumber raita, served on the side.
GOAT BIRYANI

Goat biryani represents the pinnacle of Indian culinary expertise, featuring intricate layers of exquisitely seasoned goat meat, complete with succulent bone-in pieces, harmoniously paired with delicate basmati rice. The fragrant ensemble is elegantly garnished with fresh coriander and crispy fried onions, resulting in a symphony of flavors. To complement this culinary masterpiece, one can savor it alongside a cooling raita, which adds a refreshing touch to the delightful amalgamation of heat and taste.
SHRIMP BIRYANI

Shrimp Biryani is an exquisite and flavorful culinary delight, meticulously crafted with aromatic basmati rice, succulent shrimp cooked to perfection, and onions caramelized to perfection. Accompanied by a refreshing cucumber raita, it is truly a sophisticated and delectable meal.
HALIBUT BIRYANI

Pakistani style fish biryani prepared using either wild caught halibut curry, delicately layered with fragrant Basmati rice and a rich fish biryani masala. Ensure to serve this delectable dish piping hot, accompanied by a refreshing side of raita.
VEGETABLE BIRYANI

This biryani is a delightful blend of vegetables, crispy cashews, saffron, and fragrant herbs like cilantro and mint. It truly tantalizes the taste buds, offering a harmonious symphony of flavors in each and every bite.
VEGETABLE PULAO

A delectable rice dish is crafted by expertly cooking fragrant basmati rice together with a delightful medley of vegetables, infused with the exquisite flavors of aromatic whole spices and fragrant herbs.
COCONUT RICE

Coconut Rice is a delectable rice dish crafted from the finest grated coconut, infused with a harmonious blend of tempering spices, fragrant curry leaves, and the finest grains of rice. This culinary masterpiece stands as a quintessential representation of the rich South Indian gastronomy, often prepared with utmost care and precision to grace the tables during festive occasions and momentous celebrations.
LEMON RICE

Lemon Rice holds a significant place in numerous households across South India. Regarded as a culinary staple, this delectable dish not only satiates hunger but also provides a sense of comfort and satisfaction. It is often consumed as a wholesome meal, embodying the essence of traditional cuisine.
TOMATO RICE

A highly esteemed and cherished culinary delight originating from the Tamil Nadu state of South India, renowned by the name of Thakkali Sadam in the Tamil language. This delectable masterpiece is a harmonious blend of flavors, where the tanginess of tomatoes, the aromatic spices, and the simplicity of rice come together in perfect harmony.
TAMARIND RICE

Tamarind rice or Puliyodharai is an exquisite culinary delight hailing from the southern part of India, a region renowned for its profound appreciation of the versatile grain - rice. This delectable dish takes center stage as a main course and frequently graces the tables of joyous festivities in the southern reaches of India.
